name: 4coder-markers
description: Skills that connect coding agents to the 4coder editor: explanations as markers and stories, and pseudocode implemented on request

plugins.name: explain-code
plugins.description: Explains code in the chat and, at the same time, in 4coder: markers on the important lines and a story you can step through as slides

plugins.name: pseudocode
plugins.description: Implements pseudocode sent from the 4coder editor and links every piece of pseudocode to the code that implements it, as a story the editor presents
